scholarships.title: Talents 4 UniTo — Two-Year Scholarships for International Students Enrolling in English-Taught Master's Degrees (University of Turin)

existing.description: Talents 4 UniTo is the University of Turin's programme of 40 two-year scholarships for talented international students enrolling for the first time in a postgraduate degree without a restricted number of places taught in English. Each scholarship is worth EUR 20,000 gross in total (EUR 10,000 per academic year) and holders are exempt from university tuition fees, except for the first instalment due for enrolment in each academic year. Candidates are international students who hold a qualification obtained outside the Italian system valid for admission to a postgraduate degree, do not hold Italian citizenship and are not resident in Italy. There is no separate application form: applicants are included automatically if they apply on apply.unito.it for up to two eligible programmes during the published window. Selection is carried out per programme by an Evaluation Teaching Committee on a 50-point scale with a 36-point eligibility threshold, and two scholarships are awarded per programme.
eligibility: Holds a qualification obtained at an institution outside the Italian system valid for admission to the chosen postgraduate degree, or obtains it by the final enrolment deadline for the academic year
Does not hold Italian citizenship; where Italian and another citizenship are held, the Italian citizenship prevails and the candidate is excluded

Is not resident in Italy; non-EU citizens holding a residence permit that allows enrolment at an Italian university under art. 39(5) of Legislative Decree 286/98 are treated as residents and are excluded
Meets the admission requirements of the chosen programme as published on apply.unito.it
Has submitted an application for a maximum of two postgraduate degrees without restricted access taught in English during the published window
Has English language proficiency of at least B2 level on the Common European Framework of Reference

Has never been enrolled in any degree programme, single-cycle master's degree or postgraduate degree at the University of Turin or any other Italian or foreign university, including simultaneous enrolment
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants who hold a qualification obtained at an institution outside the Italian education system that is valid for admission to a postgraduate degree, do not hold Italian citizenship, are not resident in Italy, apply to an English-taught postgraduate degree without restricted access at the University of Turin, and demonstrate English proficiency of at least B2 on the CEFR scale.
benefits: EUR 20,000 gross in total, paid as EUR 10,000 per academic year
Exemption from university tuition fees, except the first instalment due for enrolment in each academic year
coverage: EUR 20,000 gross in total, paid as EUR 10,000 per academic year
Exemption from university tuition fees, except the first instalment due for enrolment in each academic year
requirements: Apply through apply.unito.it within the published window, for a maximum of two eligible programmes
Applications sent by email are not considered, and neither are applications made through multiple Apply@Unito accounts
All documentation is thoroughly checked and fraudulent declarations constitute a criminal offence
Non-EU visa applicants residing abroad must comply with the relevant visa procedures and deadlines, including the annual ministerial provisions
Accept the scholarship by emailing internationalstudents@unito.it within 10 days of the publication of the rankings, under penalty of forfeiture, and send the completed and signed acceptance letter
Confirm that the incompatibilities in the call do not apply
If successful in more than one ranking, choose one programme and, if a non-EU visa applicant, have pre-enrolled on Universitaly for that specific programme
Complete enrolment by the deadline indicated by the International Students Office and, where applicable, obtain a study visa and submit a residence permit application
documents: Application submitted on apply.unito.it for one or two eligible programmes, with all documentation required for admission to the specific course
Qualification obtained outside the Italian education system, or proof it will be obtained by the final enrolment deadline
Evidence of English language proficiency of at least B2 CEFR
Documentation required by the chosen programme's admission requirements
For non-EU visa applicants residing abroad, compliance with the annual ministerial provisions on entry, residence and enrolment of international students in Italy
Completed and signed acceptance letter, sent after the rankings are published
existing.english_requirement: At least B2 English proficiency on the Common European Framework of Reference is mandatory. English proficiency is also one of the four scored selection criteria.
application_method: Access the apply.unito.it online procedure during the published window
Choose the programme of interest and submit the application with all documentation required for admission to that specific course
Apply to a maximum of two eligible programmes to take part in the selection
No additional scholarship application form or documentation is required
Await the programme's ranking list, published from 14 May 2026 on the University website with no personal notification
If listed as a winner, email the signed acceptance letter to internationalstudents@unito.it within 10 days
Complete enrolment, and for non-EU applicants obtain the study visa and residence permit
existing.selection_notes: Selection is carried out by the Evaluation Teaching Committee for each programme listed in the call, composed of academic staff who assess academic qualifications and personal preparation. Scholarships are awarded to the two highest-ranking candidates per programme on a maximum of 50 points, with a minimum eligibility score of 36 points. In a tie the younger candidate prevails, and scholarships not awarded by one programme cannot be reassigned to another.
existing.duration: 2 years (two academic years), paid in four instalments of EUR 5,000 gross
existing.application_period: Annual call with a fixed window. For a.y. 2026-2027 the Apply@Unito application window opened on 25 November 2025 and closed on 29 January 2026; rankings followed from 14 May 2026. The previous edition funded 38 scholarships, and the 2027-2028 call was not published at the verification date.
existing.deadline_display: Applications had to be submitted on apply.unito.it between 25 November 2025 and 29 January 2026 for the a.y. 2026-2027 cycle, and that call is now closed. Rankings were published from 14 May 2026, and ranking scroll was not possible after 30 November 2026. The next edition's window had not been published on 4 October 2026.
existing.program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in the first year of a postgraduate degree (Laurea Magistrale) without restricted access taught in English

scholarships.title: UNICORE 8.0 University Corridors for Refugees — University of Turin Scholarship (a.y. 2026-2027 / 2027-2028)
scholarships.official_source: Università degli Studi di Torino (within the UNHCR-promoted UNICORE 8.0 project)

existing.description: UNICORE 8.0 (University Corridors for Refugees) is a project promoted by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees that creates educational corridors from selected countries in Africa and Asia to Italy, in partnership with MAECI, Caritas Italiana, Diaconia Valdese and a group of Italian universities. For the 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 academic years the University of Turin awards three two-year cash-and-services scholarships for refugee students to access its open-access, English-taught Master's degree programmes. Each scholarship provides a cash benefit of EUR 7,000 gross per academic year plus exemption from all amounts due for university enrolment, except the first instalment of the student contribution. The award is paid in four instalments by bank transfer to an Italian bank account, with each payment conditional on enrolment and credit milestones.
eligibility: Resident in Bangladesh, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Ethiopia, India, Kenya, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, Zambia or Zimbabwe
Refugee status obtained in the country of residence in collaboration with UNHCR
Qualification valid for matriculation in a.y. 2026-2027 to one of the open-access Master's programmes listed in the call, obtained no earlier than 1 January 2021 and no later than 17 April 2026
GPA of 3.0 or higher, i.e. an average of at least 24/30, converted using the Italian Ministry of Education's official formula published at https://universitycorridors.unhcr.it/admission-criteria
Meets the specific admission requirements of the chosen degree programme
Has never been enrolled in a degree programme at the University of Turin or at another UNICORE partner university
English language proficiency of at least B2 on the Common European Framework of Reference
Not in receipt of the other study grants described in the call
existing.eligibility_summary: Refugee students residing in one of the listed countries who obtained refugee status in their country of residence in collaboration with UNHCR, hold a qualification obtained between 1 January 2021 and 17 April 2026 that gives access to one of the eligible open-access English-taught Master's programmes at the University of Turin, have a GPA of at least 3.0 (equivalent to 24/30 in the Italian system), meet the chosen programme's specific admission requirements, have never been enrolled in a degree programme at the University of Turin or any other UNICORE partner university, and have English proficiency of at least B2 CEFR.
benefits: EUR 7,000 gross per academic year for a.y. 2026/2027 and a.y. 2027/2028, paid in four instalments by bank transfer to an Italian bank account
Exemption from all amounts due for university enrolment in both academic years, except the first instalment of the student contribution
coverage: EUR 7,000 gross per academic year for a.y. 2026/2027 and a.y. 2027/2028, paid in four instalments by bank transfer to an Italian bank account
Exemption from all amounts due for university enrolment in both academic years, except the first instalment of the student contribution
requirements: Submit the application exclusively through the online procedure at https://universitycorridors.unhcr.it/ by 17 April 2026 at 12:00 Italian time
Attach a valid Refugee Identity card or Proof of Registration
Attach the original foreign Bachelor's degree with its official transcript, stamped and signed by the issuing institution, plus an official translation where required
Attach a motivation letter in English and a curriculum vitae
Attach the B2 English certification if held, as it is assessed
Accept the scholarship by 10 July 2026 by sending the signed and dated acceptance letter issued by the International Students Office
Submit the Universitaly university pre-enrolment application by the deadlines set by the International Students Office
Complete matriculation by paying the first instalment of the student contribution by the deadline indicated
Obtain the appropriate visa, arrive in Italy and hold the receipt of the study residence permit application by the matriculation deadline
Declare that the applicant is not in receipt of other study grants as described in the call
documents: Copy of a valid Refugee Identity card issued in collaboration with UNHCR, or of the Proof of Registration (PoR)
Original foreign academic title (Bachelor's degree) and the official study plan (transcript of records), bearing the stamp and signature of the foreign academic institution
Official translation into English or Italian if the documents were not originally issued in Italian, English, French or Spanish

English language proficiency certificate of at least B2 CEFR, if held, such as Cambridge First Certificate of English, PTE Academic, IELTS with a score of 5.5 out of 9, TOEFL iBT or Trinity College ISE II
existing.english_requirement: English proficiency of at least B2 on the Common European Framework of Reference is mandatory and is assessed. Accepted evidence includes Cambridge FCE, PTE Academic, IELTS with a score of 5.5 out of 9, TOEFL iBT and Trinity College ISE II. The eligible degree programmes are taught in English.
application_method: Register and submit the application through the UNICORE portal at https://universitycorridors.unhcr.it/
Upload the Refugee Identity card or PoR, the academic title and transcript with translations, the English motivation letter, the CV and any English certificate
Await the selection, which the project protocol splits into a documentation assessment phase and an online interview phase
If selected, receive the International Students Office communication with the acceptance method and deadline
Return the signed and dated acceptance letter by 10 July 2026
Complete Universitaly pre-enrolment, matriculation, visa and residence permit procedures
Receive the four instalments by bank transfer to an Italian current account, subject to the credit milestones
existing.selection_notes: The project is promoted by UNHCR with MAECI, Caritas Italiana, Diaconia Valdese and the partner universities; selection is based on merit and motivation and the project protocol runs in two phases, an assessment of the documentation and an online interview. Applications that are incomplete or not correctly filled in are not accepted. Winners are notified by the International Students Office, and if a winner withdraws the University proceeds down the ranking with the next eligible candidate.
existing.best_fit: Refugee students from Bangladesh pursuing Master's degrees
existing.application_period: Annual project edition with a single common deadline across participating universities. For the eighth edition the deadline was 17 April 2026 at 12:00 Italian time, with applications running from early March 2026, and students expected to arrive in Italy in September 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Applications had to be submitted exclusively through the online procedure at https://universitycorridors.unhcr.it/ by 17 April 2026 at 12:00 (noon, Italian time, UTC+2). That window has closed and the 2026/2028 edition is complete; the next edition had not been published on 4 October 2026.
existing.program_type: Refugee-student scholarship within the UNHCR-coordinated UNICORE 8.0 University Corridors project: a two-year Master's scholarship for refugee students resident in listed countries of Africa and Asia, run by the University of Turin
